object.name: Widget
object.description: This object describes an HTML widget.

annotations.description: Unique identifier of the shared widget, which can be used to send the widget again using the method sendSharedWidget; omitted if the widget isn't shared
annotations.html_description: Optional. Unique identifier of the shared widget, which can be used to send the widget again using the method sendSharedWidget; omitted if the widget isn't shared
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Unique identifier of the shared widget, which can be used to send the widget again using the method :class:`aiogram.methods.send_shared_widget.SendSharedWidget`; omitted if the widget isn't shared
annotations.name: id

annotations.description: Width of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble
annotations.html_description: Optional. Width of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Width of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble
annotations.name: width

annotations.description: Height of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the height of the widget isn't fixed

annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Height of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the height of the widget isn't fixed
annotations.name: height

annotations.description: Public data of the widget, which is available wherever the widget is shown. All messages with a shared widget have the same public data.

annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Public data of the widget, which is available wherever the widget is shown. All messages with a shared widget have the same public data.
annotations.name: public_data
